classification.difficultyReason: The student classifies five segments as radius, diameter or neither. This needs recognition of definitions only. The distractors are a chord that misses the centre, a segment ending at an interior point and a segment ending outside the circle. That is a little more discrimination than direct labelling.

content.prompt: $O$ is the centre of the circle. State whether each segment is a radius, a diameter or neither.

answer.worked: $OC$ joins the centre to a point on the circumference, so it is a radius.
$AB$ joins two points on the circumference and passes through the centre, so it is a diameter.
$CE$ joins two points on the circumference but does not pass through the centre, so it is neither.
$F$ is inside the circle, not on the circumference, so $OF$ is neither.
$OG$ starts at the centre but ends outside the circle, so it is neither.
